source.title: Cone receptor variations and their functional consequences in two species of hamster

where: Abstract (page open to the abstract only; full text behind a paywall)
value: 2 cone classes (UV-sensitive and a second near the rod peak) plus rods
method: ERG flicker photometry, behavioural discrimination and opsin antibody labelling
quote: Siberian dwarf hamsters have two classes of cone
note: Abstract only. Syrian hamster (Mesocricetus auratus) in the same paper has one cone class; that is a different species and is not logged here.
